# NAB - National Association of Long Term Care Administrator Boards

> NAB is the professional organization governing licensure, continuing education, and professional standards for Nursing Home Administrators (NHA), Resident Care/Assisted Living (RCAL), and Home and Community Based Services (HCBS) administrators across the United States.

NAB serves as the coordinating body for state regulatory boards overseeing long-term care administration. The organization develops practice standards, manages licensure pathways including the Health Services Executive (HSE) qualification, maintains continuing education registries, and supports state representatives in their governing responsibilities.

## Key Topics

- Nursing Home Administration (NHA)
- Resident Care/Assisted Living (RCAL)
- Home and Community Based Services (HCBS)
- Health Services Executive (HSE)
- Licensure Requirements
- Continuing Education
- Long-Term Care Administration
- State Representative
- Domains of Practice
- Governing Member Responsibilities
- Education Pathway
- NAB Foundation

- Professional Standards

## Getting Started with NAB

- [Home - NAB](https://nabweb.org/home): NAB homepage covering NHA, RCAL, and HCBS licensure and continuing education
- [About NAB - NAB](https://nabweb.org/about-nab-top): National Association of Long Term Care Administrator Boards organization overview
- [About NAB - NAB](https://nabweb.org/nab-foundation-top): NAB Foundation overview, mission, and donation information for long-term care
- [FAQ - NAB](https://nabweb.org/faqs-top): FAQ about NAB, NHA, RCAL licensure, and continuing education requirements

## Licensure Pathways

- [Seeking Licensure - NAB](https://nabweb.org/hse-top): HSE licensure pathway for nursing home and assisted living administration
- [Health Services Executive - NAB](https://nabweb.org/state-representative/health-services-executive): HSE qualification requirements and application process for licensure
- [States that Accept HSE - NAB](https://nabweb.org/state-representative/health-services-executive/accept-hse): List of states accepting HSE qualification for NHA and RCAL licensure
- [HSE Accredited Universities - NAB](https://nabweb.org/state-representative/health-services-executive/hse-qualified): Accredited universities offering HSE-qualified programs for administrators
- [Health Services Executive Toolkit - NAB](https://nabweb.org/state-representative/health-services-executive/hse-state-toolkit): HSE toolkit with resources and marketing materials for state representatives

## Professional Standards & Practice

- [Domains of Practice - NAB](https://nabweb.org/nab-domains-of-practise): NHA/RCAL domains of practice and professional standards framework
- [Professional Practice Analysis - NAB](https://nabweb.org/state-representative/domains-of-practice): Professional practice analysis domains for NHA, RCAL, HCBS exam content

## State Representative Resources

- [State Representative - NAB](https://nabweb.org/state-representative): State representative and governing member resources and responsibilities
- [Governing Member Responsibilities - NAB](https://nabweb.org/state-representative/governing-responsibilities): Governing member responsibilities and Board of Governors leadership structure
- [Membership Benefits - NAB](https://nabweb.org/state-representative/governing-responsibilities/membership-benefits): Membership benefits and types for NHA, RCAL, and HCBS regulatory boards
- [Membership Dues - NAB](https://nabweb.org/state-representative/governing-responsibilities/dues): NAB membership dues schedule and payment obligations for state representatives
- [NAB Bylaws - NAB](https://nabweb.org/state-representative/governing-responsibilities/bylaws): NAB bylaws, policies, and governance procedures for state representatives
- [2026-2028 Officer Elections - NAB](https://nabweb.org/state-representative/202628officers): NAB 2026-2028 officer elections and candidate information

## Continuing Education & License Verification

- [CE Registry Verification - NAB](https://nabweb.org/state-representative/ce-registry-verification): CE registry and license renewal verification for NHA and RCAL administrators
- [NABVerify API - NAB](https://nabweb.org/state-representative/ce-registry-verification/api): NABVerify API integration guide for CE registry and license verification
